records.name: Avalon Aviation Academy
records.description: Avalon Aviation Academy in Mumbai is a DGCA-approved flying training organization offering Commercial Pilot License (CPL) training and type rating programs for aspiring commercial pilots. The academy provides training on Cessna and Diamond aircraft and offers integrated and modular CPL programs designed to meet DGCA requirements. Avalon has placed graduates as first officers at major Indian airlines and has partnerships with regional carriers for streamlined placement.

records.name: Aptech Aviation Academy
records.description: Aptech Aviation Academy is part of the Aptech Limited group and one of India's largest aviation training networks, offering programs in cabin crew training, airport management, pilot ground training, and aviation hospitality. With multiple centers across major Indian cities, Aptech Aviation prepares students for careers with airlines, ground handling companies, and airport operators. The academy is affiliated with the Aptech group's global network and provides internationally aligned aviation training.

records.name: School of Aeronautics
records.description: School of Aeronautics in New Delhi is a DGCA-approved aviation training institution offering programs in aircraft maintenance engineering (AME), aeronautical engineering, and aviation management. It is one of the established AME training institutes in northern India, providing hands-on training on actual aircraft and simulators. School of Aeronautics graduates are employed by airlines, MRO companies, and aviation regulatory bodies across India.

records.name: SNDT Women's University
records.description: SNDT Women's University in Mumbai is India's first university for women, established in 1916 by Dhondo Keshav Karve, offering undergraduate, postgraduate, and doctoral programs across arts, science, commerce, and education. It is a key institution for women's empowerment through education and has a strong tradition in home science, education, and library science. SNDT Women's University has campuses in Mumbai and Pune and serves thousands of women students from Maharashtra and neighboring states.

records.name: Amity Institute of Psychology and Allied Sciences
records.description: Amity Institute of Psychology and Allied Sciences in Noida is a leading private psychology institution under Amity University, offering B.Sc. Psychology, M.Sc. Clinical Psychology, M.Phil. (Clinical Psychology), and Ph.D. programs. The institute has modern psychology labs including EEG, biofeedback, and counseling simulation rooms, and a clinical training wing. Amity's large campus network and industry connections provide students diverse internship opportunities in corporate HR, hospital psychology, and NGO mental health roles.

records.name: Christ University - Department of Psychology
records.description: Christ University's Department of Psychology in Bengaluru is one of the most sought-after psychology departments in South India, offering B.Sc., M.Sc., and Ph.D. programs in psychology with specializations in clinical, counseling, organizational, and positive psychology. The department has state-of-the-art psychology labs, a student counseling center, and industry collaborations with corporate HR departments, hospitals, and NGOs for practical training. Christ University psychology graduates are among the most employable in India's rapidly growing mental health and organizational wellness sector.

records.name: Whistling Woods International
records.description: Whistling Woods International in Mumbai is India's premier film, media, and communication arts school, established by filmmaker Subhash Ghai, offering undergraduate, postgraduate, and diploma programs in filmmaking, screenwriting, media management, and sound design. Ranked among the top 10 film schools in the world by The Hollywood Reporter, it has produced award-winning filmmakers, cinematographers, and media professionals. WWI has strong industry connections with Bollywood studios and OTT platforms, providing students exceptional practical experience and placement opportunities.

records.name: MIT Institute of Design
records.description: MIT Institute of Design (MITID) in Pune is one of Maharashtra's leading design institutions under the MIT Group, offering B.Des. and M.Des. programs in industrial design, communication design, fashion design, and UX/UI design. MITID has collaborations with international design schools and industry partners and is known for its design innovation labs and entrepreneurship support. The institute is recognized by the Design Council of India and has strong placement partnerships with design studios and technology companies.

records.name: Centurion Defence Academy
records.description: Centurion Defence Academy in Lucknow is a prominent coaching and training institution for candidates preparing for NDA, CDS, AFCAT, SSB, and other defence services examinations. It provides structured coaching, personality development, and physical fitness training aligned with SSB interview requirements. The academy has produced hundreds of officers commissioned into the Indian Army, Navy, and Air Force.

records.name: Doon Defence Academy
records.description: Doon Defence Academy in Dehradun, India's 'Defence City,' offers preparatory training for NDA, CDS, AFCAT, and SSB interviews, leveraging its proximity to IMA and other Dehradun-based defence establishments. The academy provides comprehensive coaching, physical training, and personality development tailored to defence selection processes. Dehradun's unique ecosystem of defence schools and institutions enhances the training environment at Doon Defence Academy.
